summary: Iteration-6 E2E verification of Custom Scenario Builder feature - ALL PASS. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_custom_scenarios.py covering POST /api/scenarios/custom (returns {scenario:{slug:'custom-...',custom:true,title:'TEST UI Contract'}}), GET /api/scenarios?lang=ru returns the created scenario mixed with 12 built-in and localized to Russian title (title_ru), POST /api/negotiations with custom slug + language=ru succeeds and POST /api/negotiations/{id}/message returns a Russian AI reply from the correct opponent (participant='Иван Мельников' - matches op_name_ru), DELETE /api/scenarios/custom/{slug} succeeds and item disappears from list, DELETE non-existent returns 403/404, empty title_en is accepted server-side (Pydantic doesn't enforce min_length so validation is enforced only on frontend via canSave). Frontend E2E (1440x900 desktop): (1) Login demo@negotia.app/Demo1234! via [data-testid=submit-auth] -> /dashboard. (2) /scenarios shows [data-testid=btn-create-scenario] top-right (RU 'Создать сценарий'). (3) Clicking navigates to /scenarios/new with all three sections 'Основное', 'Детали сценария', 'Оппонент' and all data-testids present: cs-title-ru/en, cs-description-ru/en, cs-category(select), cs-difficulty(select), cs-duration(number), cs-objective-ru/en, cs-context-ru/en, cs-success-ru/en, cs-op_name-ru/en (underscore convention confirmed), cs-op_role-ru/en, cs-gender-male, cs-gender-female, cs-op-description, cs-op-personality, cs-op-goals, cs-op-interests, cs-op-hidden, cs-op-constraints, cs-op-batna. (4) Validation: [data-testid=cs-save] is native-disabled (button disabled attribute) when required fields blank (canSave=false); note: on click while disabled the toast 'Заполните все обязательные (*) поля' path is unreachable via UI because the button is HTML-disabled - the toast code exists in submit() as safety net but user sees a greyed-out button instead. (5) After filling all fields + selecting Partnership/Medium/male gender, cs-save enables, click redirects to /simulate?scenario=custom-522cca83a9 and shows toast 'Сценарий создан'; wizard opens at Step 2 'Методология' with Step 01 'Сценарий' already checked (green tick). (6) Back on /scenarios: 'Ваши сценарии' section renders ABOVE 'Встроенная библиотека', custom card has 'Ваш' chip badge (Sparkles), and [data-testid=delete-custom-522cca83a9] button visible. (7) Clicking delete triggers window.confirm dialog; accepting fires DELETE /api/scenarios/custom/custom-522cca83a9, shows toast 'Удалено', card disappears (0 delete buttons remain). Test scenario cleaned up. No console errors during flows.

minor.issue: Server-side validation permits empty string for required fields (title_en, description_en, etc.); enforcement is frontend-only via canSave. Consider Pydantic min_length=1 or Field constraints to prevent API abuse via direct calls.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py CustomScenarioIn / CustomOpponent lack Pydantic Field constraints (min_length); empty strings pass validation - rely on frontend canSave only. Add min_length=1 to required *_en fields for defense-in-depth.

CustomScenarioBuilder.jsx submit() dead code: canSave gate prevents the fillRequired toast from ever showing because the button is also HTML-disabled. Either remove the pre-check toast or drop the disabled attribute so users get a clear error message when clicking with empty required fields.
Scenarios.jsx `Card` component defined inline inside render - unmounts/remounts on every render; consider hoisting for performance (minor).
server.py continues to grow (>1000 lines) - custom scenario endpoints could live in a routers/scenarios.py module for maintainability.

CustomScenarioBuilder RU-required indication is language-conditional (`required && lang==='ru'` for RU asterisk) but backend / canSave only check *_en fields - the RU asterisk is misleading; consider clarifying that only EN fields are mandatory or make both required.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted one custom scenario (custom-522cca83a9). DB clean at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Custom scenario testids use underscore for compound keys: cs-op_name-ru/en and cs-op_role-ru/en (NOT cs-op-name-ru). Delete button testid pattern is delete-<slug> where slug is 'custom-<10hex>'. The cs-save button uses native disabled attribute (not aria-disabled), so validation-fail toast is unreachable via UI. Wizard opens at Step 2 after successful save because Step 1 'Сценарий' is auto-completed from the URL query param. Auth uses [data-testid=submit-auth] for the login button; using get_by_role('button', name='Войти') is ambiguous (tab-signin conflict).
